simple.meaning: מַאֲכֹלֶת (maʼăkôleth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something eaten (by fire), i.e. fuel.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 9:4. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַאֲכֹלֶת (H3980) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
